messages:
nora: Drafting a short SOC2/audit-logs doc tweak. Goals: (1) precise default retention wording, (2) a tenant-scoped copy-pasteable example that shows redaction, (3) tiny JS SDK migration note. Can folks sanity-check?

liam: Happy to. What do you want the retention sentence to read?

nora: Thinking: "By default, Redwood retains audit logs for 90 days. Extended retention may be available under enterprise contracts; Dedicated/Private deployments allow operator-configurable retention." Keeps it conditional.

legal_omar: Sounds good. Add: "Redwood segregates tenant audit data and does not expose tenant logs to other customers. Logs are encrypted at rest; Private deployments may be configured to use customer-managed KMS. Retention and access are subject to contract terms." Also suggest a short line telling customers to route legal requests via their account contact.

liam: Agreed. For the example, I recommend showing the redacted_fields pattern and using snake_case for wire JSON. Short example below:```json
{
  "name": "model.invoke",
  "tenant_id": "acct_901",
  "data": { "prompt": "[REDACTED]" },
  "redacted_fields": ["prompt"],
  "timestamp": "2026-07-15T08:30:00Z"
}
```
Include a one-line note: "SDKs normalize to camelCase; wire-level API uses snake_case."

nora: Adding that. For the JS SDK migration snippet: old method was `client.audit.log(...)` -> new `client.audit.emit(...)`. We'll show both and mention field renames. Draft snippet:```js
// OLD
await client.audit.log({ event: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'acct_901', payload });
// NEW
await client.audit.emit({ name: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'acct_901', data: payload });
```
Add: "Note: on the wire tenant_id is used; SDK exposes tenantId in camelCase."

docs-bot: lint: SOC2 docs - avoid absolutes like "never"; add KMS note for Private deployments; operator-only curl examples should go in an appendix.

ops_june: If you include an HTTP example, make it an Operator Appendix with a clear warning about internal endpoints/auth. Example (appendix-only):```bash
# operator-only
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/v1/audit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"model.invoke","tenant_id":"acct_901","data":{}}'
```
We should not advertise internal endpoints in public docs.

legal_omar: One more legal note: add a short sentence recommending customers redact or avoid storing sensitive prompt content and that Redwood will honor contractual retention changes. Tag PR with `legal:review` once opened.

nora: Will do. I'll add the wording, include the JSON and JS snippets, append the operator curl in an appendix, and open a PR. Draft PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2688. Tagging @legal_omar and @ops_june for review.

liam: Quick copy nit: add an explicit small example of `redacted_fields: ["prompt"]` in the JS snippet so it's easy to copy-paste.

nora: done. Pushing now and will ping when CI passes. Thanks all! :shipit:
